canDoYue: 你識話走廊嘈音搞到你、問維修十點先檢查套房、問可唔可以望海港，同埋問維修幾點做完。
canDoEn: Say the hallway noise kept you up, ask maintenance to check the suite at ten before you unpack, ask for a harbour-facing room away from the hallway, and ask when maintenance finishes.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Did the hallway noise keep you from moving me to a suite?
dialogue.glossYue: 走廊嘈音搞到我，可唔可以搬我去套房？
dialogue.say: Did the hallway noise keep you from moving me to a suite?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. That hallway noise is real, and tonight I can move you.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。走廊嘈音係真嘅，我今晚可以幫你搬。
dialogue.say: Yes. That hallway noise is real, and tonight I can move you.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Will maintenance check the suite before I unpack my bag?
dialogue.glossYue: 我打開行李之前，維修會唔會先檢查套房？
dialogue.say: Will maintenance check the suite before I unpack my bag?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Maintenance will check that suite at ten, before you unpack.
dialogue.glossYue: 會。維修十點檢查嗰間套房，喺你打開行李之前。
dialogue.say: Yes. Maintenance will check that suite at ten, before you unpack.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I face the harbour if that hallway stays noisy at night?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果走廊夜晚仲嘈，可唔可以望住海港？
dialogue.say: Can I face the harbour if that hallway stays noisy at night?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Your next room can face the harbour, away from that hallway.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。下一間房可以望海港，遠離嗰條走廊。
dialogue.say: Yes. Your next room can face the harbour, away from that hallway.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: What time will maintenance finish if I keep this suite instead?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我留呢間套房，維修幾點做完？
dialogue.say: What time will maintenance finish if I keep this suite instead?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Maintenance will finish at ten, and the harbour room stays held.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。維修十點做完，海港嗰間房會留住。
dialogue.say: Yes. Maintenance will finish at ten, and the harbour room stays held.
